note.ja: 22モデル族の文献解説に、ロジスティック増殖・閉鎖SIR、線形反応拡散、Schnakenbergの線形発現・有限振幅の非線形発展・成長後の1次元パターン、空間なしFitzHugh–Nagumoの限定例を接続します。全22族の実装ではありません。別配布の固定入力例として、HHの単一細胞電流刺激、移入–死亡SSA、Fisher特殊進行波、2次元Schnakenberg境界モード、強制Keller–Segel製造問題を接続します。 別群small-modelsから、固定した4状態酵素/QSSA、正のLotka–Volterra軌道、SEIR保存則と初期2モード線形化の3例だけを追加します。SEIRはSIRの既存実行範囲とは別です。
note.en: The 22-family survey links scoped examples of logistic growth, closed SIR, linear reaction–diffusion, linear Schnakenberg onset, finite-amplitude nonlinear evolution and post-growth 1D patterns, plus spatially uniform FitzHugh–Nagumo. This does not implement all 22 families. Separate fixed-input releases add single-cell HH current controls, immigration–death SSA, a special Fisher traveling front, 2D Schnakenberg boundary modes and a forced Keller–Segel manufactured problem. Three further fixed examples from the separate small-models group cover four-state enzyme/QSSA, a positive Lotka–Volterra orbit, and SEIR conservation with full two-mode early linearization. SEIR is separate from the existing SIR execution scope.
